deviations.from: the three misconceptions register entries for topic 4.7 (retirement vs unemployment and cyclical vs structural unemployment, both on OBJ-0455-4.7.1; causes vs consequences of unemployment, on OBJ-0455-4.7.5), each normally earning one MISCON flashcard, with no MISCON slot among the 22 work-order item slots
deviations.to: three MISCON cards added beyond the slots (ITEM-0455-4.7-023-MISCON, ITEM-0455-4.7-024-MISCON, ITEM-0455-4.7-025-MISCON), each carrying its register entry's objective, misconception_entry and misconception_id, with the discrimination also taught in misconception blocks in CU-0455-4.7.1, CU-0455-4.7.4 and CU-0455-4.7.5
